'''Lex Dewiller''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Fringer/Legends|fringer]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where he owned an [[Bartender/Legends|operated]] the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Happy Landing]] in [[Tazan City]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Dewiller usually kept himself up to date with all the gossip regarding what was going on in Tazan [[City/Legends|City]].
